statement: Correspondence coloring with a fixed forbidden subgraph. Proves the Alon–Krivelevich–Sudakov coloring conjecture in correspondence-coloring form: graphs avoiding any fixed subgraph F need $`O_F(\Delta/\log\Delta)`$ colors when their maximum degree Δ is sufficiently large. Also proves the Ajtai–Erdős–Komlós–Szemerédi independence conjecture: for fixed r ≥ 4, every n-vertex Kr-free graph of average degree d ≥ 2 has an independent set of size $`\Omega_r(n\log d/d)`$.
